_doc: Ground truth for eval/run_system_eval.py, written by reading each project's source (not from Kitsune output). links: endpoint-level cross-service calls [client, server, kind, method, path]. runtime_edges: service pairs that talk at runtime but whose endpoint is only known at runtime (count for service-map recall; a 'possible' link is the best possible result). forbidden: service pairs that must NOT be linked. impact: who (which services) is affected when a handler changes.

sockshop.notes: front-end GET /orders/search/customerId is served by Spring Data REST (no annotated handler), so only a service-level link is possible.

train-ticket.upstream: https://github.com/FudanSELab/train-ticket @ 313886e (41 Java Spring Boot services + Node/Python/Go, RestTemplate)
train-ticket.held_out: Ground truth written independently before Kitsune was run on this system (2026-10-28).
train-ticket.notes: Patterns: every Java caller uses an injected (@LoadBalanced) RestTemplate and restTemplate.exchange(url, HttpMethod.X, ...). The base URL comes from a private helper getServiceUrl("ts-xxx-service") that returns "http://" + serviceName (no port; resolved through Nacos discovery). Paths are appended as string literals plus runtime ids. Sometimes the URL is first put in a local variable (stations/trains/configs/prices/path in admin-basic-info, USER_SERVICE_IP_URI in admin-user, AUTH_SERVICE_URI in user-service). Sometimes it is chosen by an if/else on the trip-id prefix (G/D goes to ts-travel-service/ts-order-service, anything else to ts-travel2-service/ts-order-other-service): admin-travel, inside-payment, rebook, route-plan. Both branches are recorded as links. The @Value(...service.url) fields are commented out. The application.yml *.url properties in ts-food-service, ts-security-service and ts-travel-service are never read by code. Unused yml entries such as travel->order and food->station are not edges, and two of those pairs are listed in forbidden on purpose. ts-user-service also calls discoveryClient.getInstances("ts-auth-service"), but only for logging. Non-Java: ts-voucher-service (Python tornado) does urllib GETs to ts-order-service/ts-order-other-service at http://ts-order-service:12031 and :12032, with env overrides. These are included as links. ts-news-service (Go), ts-ticket-office-service (Node/express), ts-avatar-service (Python flask) and ts-delivery-service make no outbound service calls. Queues (RabbitMQ): ts-preserve-service and ts-preserve-other-service convertAndSend to queue "email", consumed by ts-notification-service (@RabbitListener). ts-food-service sends to "food_delivery", consumed by ts-delivery-service. ts-notification-service also sends to its own "email" queue (test endpoint); that is a self-edge and is excluded. Runtime edges: ts-ui-dashboard nginx proxy_pass /api/v1/ -> ts-gateway-service:18888. ts-gateway-service (Spring Cloud Gateway) routes lb://<svc> for 38 services by Path predicates; the paths are wildcards, so these are service-level only. Excluded: the ts-inside-payment-service AsyncTask getForObject("http://rest-service-external:16100/greet"), because its target is not a repo service. Browser JS in ts-ui-dashboard/static calls relative /api/v1/... URLs through nginx, so it is not counted per-service. Uncertain/buggy calls, all verified against the controllers: (1) ts-wait-order-service PollThread POSTs to ts-preserve-service at /api/v1/contactservice/preserve. ts-preserve-service only exposes /api/v1/preserveservice/preserve, so there is no matching route. The pair is kept as a runtime_edge only. (2) ts-rebook-service deleteOrder sends POST to /api/v1/orderservice/order/{*} (and the orderOther equivalent). The target has only GET/DELETE on that pattern, so the method does not match and these two are excluded from links; the service pairs are already covered by other links. ts-basic-service calls /api/v1/routeservice/routes/byIds/ with a trailing slash, normalized to /routes/byIds. Config, contacts and travel-plan controllers use class prefixes without a leading slash (api/v1/...); they are treated as rooted. | Amended after the blind run (2026-10-28): seat->config was written as /configs/{*}, but configName is a local constant ("DirectTicketAllocationProportion") in SeatServiceImpl.getDirectProportion, so the called path is literal. Blind first-run scores: link precision 0.798, recall 0.621.
